title: Off-shell homogeneous Bianchi-I to FLRW tangency gate for minimal 4D N=1 supergravity with one neutral chiral multiplet
registration_scope: This Stage-A contract is frozen before its source packet, convention map, reduction certificate, executable, or result is created or observed. It stops at the off-shell homogeneous tangency gate. Dirac-Bergmann stabilization, graded canonical closure, differentiability, physical charges, and relational branches require later contracts and cannot be adapted after observing this result.

scope_lock.parent_background: A nondegenerate homogeneous Bianchi-I tetrad on compact T^3 with periodic spin structure. Anisotropic and off-diagonal modes remain present until their transformations are computed.
scope_lock.candidate_restriction: The isotropic spatially-flat FLRW locus is only a candidate submanifold. Its equations may be pulled back for a diagnostic, but it is not imposed as a valid supersymmetric truncation before the tangency gate passes.
scope_lock.matter: One neutral chiral multiplet Z=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), K_phys=Z Zbar, calK=K_phys/M_P^2, W identically zero, no vectors or gauging.
scope_lock.spin_connection_formalism: Second-order component formalism with the torsionful spin connection treated as the composite omega(e,psi) in the frozen source convention. No independent omega_mu or omega_0 multiplier is assumed in Stage A.
scope_lock.tangency_domain: The tangency calculation lives on the first homogeneous jet space J^1. The source/convention/mode packet must freeze every independent field jet and parameter jet used by the selected transformations, including the required components of dot e, dot Z, dot psi, epsilon, and dot epsilon. N, homogeneous shift components, and psi_0 remain retained multiplier/gauge jets unless the source-derived transformation and preregistered ledger justify another treatment. No equation of motion identifies independent jets.

allowed: regular local homogeneous time diffeomorphisms with lapse variation derived from the frozen transformation law, not an independent lapse redefinition

globally periodic homogeneous-compatible spatial diffeomorphisms generated by periodic vector fields and retained shift transformations; continuous GL(3) coordinate shear/scale is excluded unless globally realized on the frozen T^3
regular local Lorentz transformations acting within the retained tetrad/gravitino field space
allowed_compensators.requirements: Every compensator must be derived from the frozen transformation laws, be regular on the declared nondegenerate patch, and be fixed before inspecting the tangency remainder. PHASE15A_MODE_COMPENSATOR_LEDGER.json must freeze its coefficient ring, allowed localization denominators, field dependence, Grassmann parity, and time-derivative order.
forbidden: use of equations of motion or undeclared canonical constraints
a compensator living only in a discarded mode
branch reflection, CPT, pseudo-supersymmetry, or an appended worldline symmetry

scope_lock.claim_ceiling: A pass can establish only that the source-derived homogeneous off-shell transformations are tangent to the candidate FLRW locus modulo the frozen kinematic compensator class. It cannot establish a canonical Dirac bridge, arbitrary epsilon(x), quantum closure, Q_phys, or branch exchange.

source_lock.role: Kahler-superspace minimal 4D N=1 component action, old-minimal auxiliary-field content, chiral matter couplings, and SUSY transformations. It is not a canonical source.
Time-gauge canonical and convention cross-check only. Its explicit minisuperspace equations are k=+1 on S^3 and may not be converted to k=0 by deleting a curvature-looking term.
Bianchi type-A pure self-dual SUGRA reduction/closure control only; no chiral matter or target transformation derivation.
Matter-free FLRW ansatz-preservation scope control only; its imposed spin-3/2 condition and matter-free transformations are not the target parent.

target_claims.hypothesis: After reducing the frozen 4D off-shell transformation laws to homogeneous Bianchi-I, the candidate isotropic FLRW locus is tangent to homogeneous local-supersymmetry transformations modulo only the preregistered regular kinematic compensators.
target_claims.necessary_not_sufficient: A pass only permits a separately preregistered canonical Stage B. It does not show constraint closure or a physical charge.

convention_requirements: Freeze metric signature, epsilon tensors, sigma matrices, Majorana/Weyl conjugation, left/right Grassmann derivatives, and every component-field transformation sign.
Freeze M_P, V_0, K_phys/M_P^2, lapse, tetrad, chiral-field, and gravitino normalizations and give an explicit Hohl-to-local-variable map.
Freeze the second-order composite-spin-connection convention and do not introduce omega_0 as an independent multiplier.
Retain M, Mbar, b_a, F, Fbar and every fermion order present in the selected off-shell transformations used by the tangency test.
Freeze the full J^1 jet list, retained and discarded Bianchi-I/FLRW modes, FLRW defining functions, transverse projector, and allowed compensator ansatz before the executable is created.
Do not obtain k=0 by deleting a term from an explicit k=1 S^3 minisuperspace formula or by setting a fiducial-volume normalization to zero.

acceptance: freeze exact source versions, official-TeX hashes, equation scopes, and distinct-source roles
freeze a machine-readable convention map, second-order spin-connection choice, complete J^1 jet ledger, retained/discarded mode ledger, and compensator ansatz
freeze FLRW defining functions f^alpha=0, prove their Jacobian has constant rank on the declared patch, and verify ker(P_perp)=T(FLRW locus)
freeze the compensator normal map A, its coefficient ring/localization, parity and jet order so the physical tangency obstruction is the exact cokernel class [P_perp X_SUSY] in coker(A)
reject k=1 curvature deletion, source stacking, or a claim that a source already derives the compact k=0 matter model
specialize the selected off-shell 4D action and transformations to canonical neutral chiral matter with W identically zero before homogeneous reduction
derive the full retained Bianchi-I bosonic body and homogeneous transformations on the frozen J^1 jet space without imposing isotropy or equations of motion
retain auxiliaries and every fermion order that contributes to the discarded-mode variations
as a diagnostic only, verify that the formal isotropic pullback of the bosonic body reproduces C_B=-p_X^2+p_T^2+p_Y^2 with X=sqrt(6) M_P ln a up to an explicitly positive densitization
evaluate the source-derived homogeneous transformation of every preregistered discarded anisotropic, off-diagonal, gravitino, chiralino, and auxiliary mode on the candidate FLRW locus
solve the frozen regular kinematic compensator equations without using equations of motion, undeclared constraints, nonlocality, or a discarded-mode compensator
evaluate P_perp X_SUSY on the candidate locus and reduce it by the frozen compensator normal map A; the exact obstruction is its class in coker(A)
require the cokernel class to vanish identically for arbitrary retained homogeneous J^1 data and homogeneous epsilon/dot epsilon jets on the declared patch
verify the result with an exact Grassmann/exterior monomial representation rather than commuting fermion symbols
make no statement about Dirac-Bergmann constraints, graded canonical closure, full 3+1 differentiability, arbitrary epsilon(x), quantum theory, Q_phys, or branch exchange
leave both Phase 14A physics claims frozen with no evidential inheritance

invalid_if: an executable or result is created or observed before this contract is committed
an explicit k=1 reduced formula is converted to k=0 by deleting a term without a 4D reduction
distinct source roles are presented as one source-derived target model
a compensator is added after inspecting a nonzero tangency remainder
homogeneous epsilon(t) evidence is generalized to arbitrary epsilon(x) or a canonical/quantum claim
the same exact K2 observation is classified as both SUPPORTS and CONTRADICTS
supports_if: K0 and K1 are complete and valid

the J^1 ledger, FLRW defining functions, constant-rank transverse projector, compensator normal map, coefficient ring/localization, and discarded-mode census were frozen in a separate commit before the executable
K2 has zero exact compensator-cokernel class for every discarded mode and arbitrary retained homogeneous jet data
contradicts_if: K0 and K1 are complete and valid
the discarded-mode and allowed-compensator census is complete under the frozen source map

K2 leaves an exact nonzero compensator-cokernel class, or supplies one exact in-domain cokernel witness after proving the quotient residual is not identically zero and that the full frozen regular compensator system has no allowed solution at that witness
inconclusive_if: a required source/action/transformation term, convention map, mode, or fermion order is missing
the compensator system is unresolved or its regularity is unproved
the source-to-local transformation map cannot be completed
verdict_precedence: a complete frozen compensator quotient with an exact nonzero cokernel class gives CONTRADICTS
a complete frozen compensator quotient identically zero on the full declared jet domain gives SUPPORTS
every incomplete or unresolved case gives INCONCLUSIVE with qualification UNCONSTRUCTED
simultaneous SUPPORTS and CONTRADICTS gives INVALID with qualification INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY
frozen_decision.artifact_order: Commit contract first. In a second, separate pre-result commit freeze the source packet, convention map, and mode-compensator ledger. Only after that commit may a third commit add the complete Stage-A executable. Only then perform the first scientific run. The reduction certificate, run result, and replay receipt are post-run result artifacts and must not be created before the first execution.
frozen_decision.sequencing_rule: Stage A stops after K2/K3. Only a SUPPORTS result may motivate a separately preregistered Phase 15B Dirac-Bergmann/closure cycle. Phase 14A remains unchanged, Phase 14B remains closed, and any later physical-charge cycle must preregister its own candidate class and support gates.

semantic_mutants: delete a k=1 curvature term and call the result k=0
set a fiducial-volume normalization to zero
impose isotropy before deriving the Bianchi-I transformations
omit an anisotropic or off-diagonal gravitino mode from the discarded ledger
drop M, b_a, F, or a fermion term contributing to a discarded-mode variation
introduce a compensator only after seeing the residual
use equations of motion or an undeclared constraint as a compensator
represent Grassmann-odd fields as ordinary commuting symbols
infer canonical closure, Q_phys, or branch exchange from off-shell tangency

classification_policy.novelty_scope: SOURCE_SCOPED only after a complete exact target relation, independent replay, and a separate literature-novelty audit; no literature-priority or confirmation claim. Source and normalization controls remain REPRODUCTION.

comparison_policy.symbolic: exact rational/algebraic equality under the frozen convention map
comparison_policy.grassmann: exact exterior-monomial equality at every retained fermion degree
comparison_policy.matrix: exact even-body matrix equality/rank and explicit inverse multiplication where used in Stage A; no mixed supermatrix determinant claim

non_goals: Dirac-Bergmann constraint stabilization or a canonical bracket
quantization, anomaly freedom, or a physical inner product
a relational expansion/contraction projector or branch exchange
